#  12431 - Designing and Implementing Web Applications Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12431 - Phase-out Module**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Designing and Implementing Web Applications**  |  
|  Entwurf und Implementierung von Webanwendungen   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. phil. habil. Wagner, Gerd 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students get familiar with important web concepts and technologies, and acquire the methodological skills required for developing web applications. In particular, they learn fundamental information management concepts (enumerations, integrity constraints and data validation, associations, inheritance in class hierarchies) and how to use techniques of Model-Driven Development.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * JavaScript Front-End Web Applications
  * From JavaScript to TypeScript 
  * Distributed Web Applications with Firebase Cloud Services

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Participants must have good knowledge in Java-programming and web-technologies, equivalent to module 12316 (Specification Languages and Processing Techniques for Web Documents).  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Research paper/essay / 60 Hours 
  * Self organised studies / 60 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Will be distributed during the course.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Successful completion of project assignments, scope depends on task (40%)
  * 10-12 online tests, 15 min. each (50%)
  * Participation in class meetings, discussion forum, etc. (10%)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Maschinenbau / keine PO 

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme eBusiness M.Sc.: Mandatory modul

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecture: Designing and Implementing Web Applications
  * Accompanying exercises

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 19.04.2023 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
